title: Classifying Carbons (1°, 2°, 3°, 4°)
notes:
Classifying Carbons (1°, 2°, 3°, 4°)

• 1° (Primary): Bonded to 1 other carbon.
• 2° (Secondary): Bonded to 2 other carbons.
• 3° (Tertiary): Bonded to 3 other carbons.
• 4° (Quaternary): Bonded to 4 other carbons.
summary: Degree of substitution on carbon atoms in aliphatic & cyclic structures.
